Today, we updated the Beta with a new build that includes the following updates.

Change Log

  • Bugfixes
    • Fixed a bug with casters not playing their precast animations.
    • Fixed an issue where a buff could not be applied.
      • Players may now buff each other.
  • Classes
    • If you have not recently logged in, your talents have been reset.
    • Hunter
      • Pets
        • Pet attack speed normalised.
      • Marksmanship
        • Aimed Shot cast time reduced to 2.5 seconds (was 3 seconds).
    • Paladin
      • Retribution Aura base damage returned to the original values.
      • Protection
        • Reckoning: Now has a 1.5 second cooldown.
          • Developers’ notes: This keeps burst in check.
  • Races
    • Tauren
    • Cultivation now has a cast time.
  • Quests
    • Elwynn Forest - Increased the spawn rate of Kobolds.
    • Durotar - Reduced the damage of Scorpids.

New to this build - Known Issues

  • Banes and Curses do not properly stack.

Our full Known Issues post is here.
